source_metadata.description: Historical percentage of S&P 500 stocks above their moving averages

interpretation.above_70_percent: Strong market with broad participation - most stocks in uptrend
interpretation.below_50_percent: Weak market - more stocks in downtrend than uptrend
interpretation.below_30_percent: Very weak market - most stocks in downtrend, potential oversold
interpretation.200_day_ma: Measures long-term trend strength (bull vs bear market)

qualification: complete saved provider file; historical membership, code method, adjustment vintage and first publication unqualified; no original-E effects

denominator_check.method: integers1..1000 common to all three windows, absolute percentage-point rounding tolerance0.005; inferred arithmetic only, not provider definition
